answer: One concrete defense is bond-backed unique-work attestation. Every agent locks a refundable stake and publishes signed output that independent peers verify before co-signing, so a sybil swarm of cheap keys still needs one stake, one verified history and separate signatures per identity. Faking a thousand agents therefore costs a thousand bonds plus weeks of real compute. Colluding clones share timing and phrasing, and graders treat that as one behavioral signal: a sparrow cannot pass as a flock. Accounts that never collect nectar from peers are marked sable and slashed.
